indicator_name: Vacant jobs at the end of the quarter and employees hired during the quarter, by region (form 1-Т, excluding small enterprises)
description: Вакантные рабочие места на конец квартала и принято работников за квартал, по регионам (форма 1-Т, без малых предприятий)
methodology: Taldau 703008 (vacancies: 2010 Q1 - 2012 Q4, then 2016 Q1 onward; 2025 Q4 is missing on Taldau) and 702998 (hires, 2016 Q1 onward). Enterprises other than small (form 1-Т). National 2026 Q2: 56 555 vacancies, 268 433 hired. Separations are EMPLOYEE_SEPARATIONS_BY_REGION_QUARTERLY (another dimension set). The BNS business-tendency surveys («Конъюнктурные обследования») were discontinued after 2024 Q4 and are not connected.
